title: Affine K-flatness with the section ring kept bundled
statement: For a bundled commutative ring A, an A-module M, and a projective resolution P of M, sheafification on Spec A of the nonpositive extension of the resolution complex is K-flat. This is the existing affine K-flatness theorem with its ring retained as a bundled object. Definitions: [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].

source.place: Tag 08DV, associated sheaf of a K-flat complex; bounded-above projective resolutions are K-flat.

proof.text: Destruct the bundled commutative ring A. Apply the existing tensorResolution_isKFlat theorem to the underlying ring, M, and P. Both the scheme and complex in its conclusion are now definitionally those in the statement. The reused theorem combines bounded-above flat K-flatness for the extended projective resolution with preservation of K-flatness under associated sheaf; the two cited nodes record those mathematical dependencies.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorResolution_isKFlat_bundledRing
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (P : ProjectiveResolution M) :
    CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := (Spec A).sheaf)
      (((tilde.functor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (P.complex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat))
